hints.content: Each week, the number of teams registered grows by a constant **amount**, so it is best to use a linear graph to model it.
A linear graph appears as a straight line.

The graph that best represents the relationship between time and the number of teams registered is:

![An increasing graph with a constant, positive slope.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/0c0eacf9b0cb2c11e45724a1d302de5097f4059e)

question.content:
You are helping to organize a soccer tournament by registering the participating teams.  Each week $6$ teams register to participate.

**Which graph best represents the relationship between time and the number of teams registered?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

choices.content: ![An increasing graph with a constant, positive slope.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/0c0eacf9b0cb2c11e45724a1d302de5097f4059e)
![An increasing graph that curves more steeply as x increases.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/51e01ed550d02d785b066d3b55a8d3b8fcd5df3b)
